caption: The drawing depicts a small, ornate handbag or purse with a metallic frame and a chain handle. The purse itself is predominantly light purple and features a detailed beaded or embroidered design. The upper section of the bag has green leaves and red and blue flowers with yellow centers. The lower section of the bag is decorated with a red band containing motifs of two small houses—one white and one blue—alongside yellow and green stylized bushes or trees. The bottom edge of the purse is finished with a blue patterned band. The metallic frame of the purse is grey and designed with engraved floral patterns and two rounded knobs at the closure. The chain handle is drawn in a loose curve and is grey in color. The entire purse is set against a plain light beige background and is framed by a single black outline forming a square around it.
title: Bag
